_common: Pixel art game effect for a top-down 3/4-view monster battle game. Small: fits a {size} pixel canvas, centered, transparent background, crisp pixels with a dark outline where it helps readability, bright saturated colours. One-shot (not looping), about {n} frames, ends fully faded out.
_loop: Pixel art game sprite for a top-down 3/4-view monster battle game. Small: fits a {size} pixel canvas, centered, transparent background, crisp pixels with a 1px dark outline, bright saturated colours. A seamless LOOPING animation of about {n} frames (last frame flows into the first). If it travels, it points/flies to the RIGHT and stays in place on the canvas (the game moves and rotates it).
